bugs.what: vm: DEFINE_GLOBAL does not bump the globals version, so cached global reads go stale after a top-level redeclaration
resolver dedupes free variables by bare slot/index numbers, so a parent local and a grandparent variable can share one free slot (3-level closures)
kmap.find treats every negative slot (EMPTY and DELETED) as the end of the probe chain: keys behind a removed key become unreachable, re-storing them duplicates them
kmap.resize indexes entries by their position before removed entries are compacted away: after removals, a growth step makes keys point at the wrong entries

    def resize(self):
